chart.programText:
A = data('revision_request_count', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['inferenceservice', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('revision_request_count', filter=filter('response_code_class', '4xx'), rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['inferenceservice', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='B')
C = data('revision_request_count', filter=filter('response_code_class', '5xx')).sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['inferenceservice', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='C')

chart.description: Percentage of requests dropped between queue-proxy and app
chart.name: Request drop rate
chart.programText:
A = data('revision_request_count', rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='A', enable=False)
B = data('revision_app_request_count', rollup='rate').sum().publish(label='B', enable=False)
C = ((A-B)/A).scale(100).publish(label='C')

chart.programText:
A = data('revision_request_count', rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='A')
B = data('revision_request_count', filter=filter('response_code', '4*'), rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='B')
C = data('revision_request_count', filter=filter('response_code', '5*'), rollup='delta').sum(over=Args.get('ui.dashboard_window', '15m')).sum(by=['k8s.pod.name', 'k8s.cluster.name']).publish(label='C')
D = ((B+C)/A).scale(100).publish(label='D', enable=False)
